scores.label: A
scores.note: No zeros. Option 1 is a clean, natural paraphrase ('produce little'). Option 2 'very little' slightly strengthens 'not a lot' and 'many greenhouse gases' is loose. Option 3 'significant greenhouse gases' needs 'amounts of'. Option 4 is longer and spells out the coal/oil contrast. Option 5 is correct but wordy. negation_changed flags are faithful rewordings of 'do not release a lot'.
